# CLM eForm spec

`src/clm-eform-spec.ts` compiles an eForm spec (JSON) into the HTML of a classic CLM eForm, to paste into the
designer's HTML box. A solution manifest names it in `clmEforms` ([SOLUTION-SPEC.md](SOLUTION-SPEC.md)); the bundle
carries `eforms/<id>.html` and its steps `eforms/<id>.md`. Library specs: `assets/clm-eforms/specs/` (the five Fontara
forms, each checked against the HTML saved in the account: `assets/clm-eforms/live/`, `scripts/clm-eform-verify.ts`).
The product facts are in [CLM-EFORMS-GUIDE.md](CLM-EFORMS-GUIDE.md) and [CLM-EFORMS-HTML.md](CLM-EFORMS-HTML.md).

## Top level

| Key | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | kebab-case | the file name; the bundle's `eforms/<id>.html` |
| `name` | string | the form's name in CLM; a submission is `<name>.sxform`, then `(1)`, `(2)`… |
| `description` | string | the intro at the top of the form |
| `sections` | `[{ title, help?, showIf?, repeating?, fields }]` | the form, in order; each section is a `<fieldset>` |
| `submitFolder` | string | Routing ▸ Set Submit Folder: the folder path below the root (it must exist) |
| `workflow` | string | Routing ▸ Set Workflow: a published CLM workflow's name, or the id of one of the manifest's `clmWorkflows` |
| `allowUpdates` | boolean | Access ▸ Allow Updates: a submitted form reopens as Update Form and saves over itself |
| `repositoryAttachments` | boolean | Access ▸ Enable Repository Attachments |
| `attributeIds` | `{ "Group.Field": "<GUID>" }` | the account's attribute field ids, when known |
| `keepIds` | string[] | custom ids that submitted forms already hold: the compile refuses a spec without one of them |
| `styles` | string[] | stylesheets linked before the form's own style: an https `.css` URL (a CDN, as the Contract Request form links Bootstrap) or a CSS file kept in CLM by its `/clm/atlas/documents/get.ashx/…` path (as the Third-Party Paper form does); proven 2026-11-02 (B4-E1: CLM keeps the link and the page loads it) |

## Fields

| `kind` | Keys | Compiles to | Saved as |
|---|---|---|---|
| `attribute` | `attribute` ("Group.Field"), `label?`, `help?`, `required?`, `readOnly?`, `placeholder?`, `default?` | `<springcm:MetaFieldInput metadatafieldid="…"/>` (`required="true"`, `readonly`, `placeholder` copied to the control); no `label`: `<springcm:MetaFieldLabel>` | an attribute on the `.sxform` |
| `text`, `textarea`, `number`, `date`, `email` | `id`, `label`, `help?`, `required?`, `placeholder?` | an `<input>` / `<textarea>` with `id` and `name` | custom data by `id` |
| `select` | `id`, `label`, `options` (strings or `{ value, label }`), `required?` | a `<select>` with a blank first option and a `value` on every option | custom data |
| `checkbox` | `id`, `label`, `value?` (default `Yes`) | `<input type="checkbox" value="…">` | custom data (the value when ticked) |
| `attachment` | `label`, `count?` (1–10), `required?`, `help?` | `<springcm:FileAttachmentInput InitialAttachmentCount="n"/>` | each file a document in the submit folder |
| `note` | `text` | a paragraph | — |
| `html` | `html` | static HTML (a reference table); no controls, scripts, buttons or springcm tags | — |

Every field and section takes `showIf`: `{ "field": "<custom id or Group.Field>", "equals": "x" | ["x", "y"] }`,
`notEquals`, or `"notBlank": true`; or `{ "any": [ … ] }` / `{ "all": [ … ] }`.

- A `default` on an attribute is set in the load script when the field is empty (`defaultvalue` on the tag is not applied).
- `required` on an attribute that no rule can hide is CLM's own check (`required="true"`); on a custom field, or on a
  field a rule can hide, the save script checks it while it is shown. A required attachment that is always shown is
  the form's Access ▸ Attachment Required (in the steps); one a rule can hide is checked by the script.
- A `repeating` section is an attribute set the user adds rows to: attribute fields only, no show-if on its fields.

## Refused (each a reason a value goes missing, CLM-EFORMS-HTML §E)

| Refusal | Why |
|---|---|
| a custom field without `id`, or an id that is not camelCase letters and digits | the id is the key; `CustomFormFields` in workflow Params drops other characters |
| one id twice, or two ids that differ only in case | CLM saves one value, joined with a comma |
| `kind: "radio"` | radios are renamed one by one and are not exclusive: use `select` |
| an option without a value | on reopen the saved option shows twice |
| `checkbox` with `value: ""` | CLM would save `on` |
| a custom field with `searchable: true` | a custom answer is not an attribute: not searchable, not in reports, not attribute routing |
| a control, script, button or springcm tag inside `html` | an undeclared or script-built control is not saved; only CLM's Save stores values |
| a custom field or attachment in a `repeating` section | saved without its set name, or not at all |
| a `keepIds` id missing from the spec | earlier submissions keep their answer under it |
| a `showIf` naming no field of the form, or a field of a repeating set | the rule could never run |
| more than 180 attributes | the eForm limit [brief] |

## Example

```json
{
  "id": "nda-intake", "name": "NDA Request", "submitFolder": "Legal/NDA Requests",
  "workflow": "nda-review",
  "sections": [
    { "title": "The NDA", "fields": [
      { "kind": "select", "id": "ndaType", "label": "NDA type", "options": ["Mutual", "One-way"], "required": true },
      { "kind": "attribute", "attribute": "External Party.Business Name", "label": "Counterparty", "required": true },
      { "kind": "attribute", "attribute": "Agreement.Third Party", "label": "On their paper?" },
      { "kind": "attachment", "label": "Their draft", "required": true, "showIf": { "field": "Agreement.Third Party", "equals": "Yes" } }
    ] }
  ]
}
```
